_description: Schema contract + ontology for the Indian agriculture knowledge skeleton. Two record types: entities and relations. All facts are deterministic — each entity/relation carries a source reference registered in sources.md. No LLM-generated facts. The ontology (classes, properties, predicates) is the canonical contract: every (domain, type) maps to exactly one Class, each Class has one required/optional property schema, and every predicate declares domain/range/inverse. Same concept = same key everywhere.

field_specs.id: Unique dotted id, e.g. soil.black_soil. URI-like so KG conversion is trivial.
field_specs.name: Canonical English name.
field_specs.aliases: Alternate names / local names (English only for now). May include AGROVOC prefLabels via agrovocId.
field_specs.domain: One of the domain roots defined below.
field_specs.type: Entity type from the type taxonomy below.
field_specs.attributes: Factual attribute map (deterministic, citeable). Keys MUST follow the property contract of the entity's Class (see classes).
field_specs.relations: Array of relation objects: {predicate, object, source?}.
field_specs.notes: Free-text: coverage state, gap notes, TODO markers.
field_specs.agrovocId: Optional AGROVOC concept URI for cross-linking to agrovoc_entities_filtered.json.

relation._predicate_contract: Every predicate declares domain (source Class) and range (target Class or 'Location'). A relation is valid only if the source entity's Class is in domain and the object's Class is in range. inverse names the reverse predicate (may be unidirectional: inverse null).

part_of.desc: part of a larger entity (e.g. domain part_of agriculture)

found_in.desc: located/found in a location (soil in states)

registered_in.desc: registered/approved by an institution (pesticides, varieties, livestock breeds)

controlled_by.desc: controlled by a substance/measure (pest controlled_by pesticide)

affects.desc: affects a crop/plant/livestock/season (pest affects crop, weather event affects crop)

requires.desc: requires a resource (crop requires soil type). Domain mirrors suited_for range — a category of crops may require a soil as an aggregate fact.

suited_for.desc: soil suited for crop. Range mirrors requires domain.

grown_in_state.desc: DEPRECATED convenience of grown_in — do not use; kept for backward compat

domains.location: Anchor: India -> states/UTs -> districts + agro-climatic zones + regions.
domains.soil: Soil types of India, characteristics, distribution, suitability.
domains.crops: All crops: cereals, millets, pulses, oilseeds, fibres, sugar, horticulture, spices, plantation, fodder; seasons, varieties, agronomy.
domains.livestock: Cattle, buffalo, goat, sheep, pig, poultry, camel, yak, mithun; breeds (NBAGR), dairy, diseases.
domains.pesticides: Registered pesticides (CIB&RC), classes, banned/restricted list, biopesticides.
domains.fertilizers: Chemical fertilizers, biofertilizers, manures, NPK norms.
domains.organic: Organic farming, NPOP/PGS-India certification, organic states, inputs, methods.
domains.water: Irrigation systems, water resources, river basins, groundwater.
domains.weather: Monsoon, seasons, agro-climatic zones, climate of India.
domains.seeds: Seed types, hybrid/variety lists, certification, seed corps.
domains.machinery: Farm machinery and implements used in India.
domains.plant_protection: Pests, diseases, weeds affecting Indian crops.
domains.fisheries: Marine, inland, aquaculture species and producing states.
domains.post_harvest: Storage, cold chain, processing, grading, losses.
domains.market: Mandis, APMC, MSP, e-NAM, exports, insurance.
domains.schemes: Government schemes and agricultural institutions (ICAR, SAUs, KVKs).
domains.forestry: Forests, timber, non-timber forest products, agroforestry.
domains.finance: Agricultural finance: institutional credit, KCC, PSL, refinance, insurance subvention.

classes._description: Class hierarchy. Each Class maps to a (domain, type) set. The property contract (required/optional + value type) is the canonical, data-backed schema — every entity of that Class MUST only use keys from required ∪ optional. This is the 'same format in all sub-domains' rule: e.g. SoilType is one Class whether the entity lives in soil.json or is referenced from crops.json.
classes._class_mapping: Each entry: {domains: [...], types: [...], description, required: [...], optional: {...key: value_type_or_spec}}. required keys are present in >=95% of current entities of that Class. optional value types: str | int | float | bool | list | dict | list_of_objects | list_of_strings | dict_of_numbers.

Crop.desc: A crop species/variety grown in India. The most interlinked class: referenced from soil, pesticides, market, plant_protection, weather, seeds, fertilizers.

apy_stats.desc: {latest_fy: {area, production, yield}, source, note} — full series in data/_generated

SoilType.desc: A soil type (alluvial, black, laterite...). Canonical node: crops.json references these via requires, soil.json owns them.

Pest.desc: An insect/mite pest of a crop. Ids: plant_protection.pest.*

PlantDisease.desc: A fungal/bacterial/viral disease of a crop. Ids: plant_protection.disease.*

PesticideSubstance.desc: A registered pesticide active ingredient (class is the CIB&RC registration class). Banned/restricted actives also map here (type: substance) — they lack the registration class, which is why class is optional.

LivestockBreed.desc: An indigenous or improved livestock breed (NBAGR).

LivestockVariety.desc: A livestock variety/breed record with origin.

Institution.desc: Government scheme or institution (ICAR, SAUs, KVKs, CIB&RC...). Canonical node referenced from many domains.

Measure.desc: Practice, technique, method, scheme, or standard.

FisherySpecies.desc: A marine/inland/aquaculture species or fishery group.

ForestEntity.desc: A forest/timber/NTFP species or forest-status entity.

WaterEntity.desc: A river basin, water resource, or irrigation-status entity.

WeatherEvent.desc: A weather/climate event (monsoon, drought, cyclone, El Nino).

WeatherEntity.desc: A weather phenomenon or season entity.

SeedEntity.desc: A seed type, hybrid, or variety record.

OrganicEntity.desc: An organic farming entity (area, input, state status).

FinanceEntity.desc: An agricultural finance instrument/measure (KCC, PSL, subvention...).

PostHarvestEntity.desc: A post-harvest entity (loss category, storage, processing).

GenericEntity.desc: Generic concrete entities not captured by a specialised class.

key_aliases._description: Canonical key resolution. Only the LEFT key may appear in data. Migration renames right->left. Verified: no entity carries real content in both keys of a pair. NOTE: 'species' (livestock common name, e.g. pig/cattle) and 'character' (soil description) are NOT aliases of 'scientific' — they are semantically distinct and kept as-is.

conventions.name_language: English only (v1); Hindi/local names allowed in aliases only
conventions.location_refs: Location relations MUST resolve to ids in data/locations/*.json
conventions.source_refs: Every entity and every relation MUST carry a source id present in sources.md
conventions.gap_marking: Uncollected leaf-level data is marked in notes with TODO + expected count, never fabricated
conventions.kg_ready: KG conversion = emit (id, predicate, object) for every relation; entities become nodes
conventions.class_contract: Attribute keys of an entity MUST be within its Class's required ∪ optional. Unknown keys, deprecated aliases, and synonym co-presence (note+notes, use+uses, type+types, scientific+species) are validation warnings now, errors once conformance is declared complete.
conventions.inverse_consistency: suited_for <-> requires and part_of <-> has_part are inverse pairs; both directions may coexist and are treated as the same logical fact (owl:inverseOf).
